caseName: E T & W N C Transportation Co. v. Currie
caseNameFull: E T & W N C TRANSPORTATION CO. v. CURRIE, COMMISSIONER OF REVENUE OF NORTH CAROLINA
attorneys: Kester Walton and James H. Epps, Jr. for appellant.
judges: Cases, Frankfurter, Opinions, Stated, Stewart, Whittaker

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed. Northwestern States Portland Cement Co. v. Minnesota, and Williams v. Stockham Valves & Fittings, Inc., 358 U. S. 450.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter, Mr. Justice Whittaker and Mr. Justice Stewart dissent for the reasons stated in the dissenting opinions in these cases.
